title: Panda Beastman
text: “Excuse me. It seems this child has the potential to transform into a Beastman—do you happen to know how to do it?”

My father asks passersby this, but they just give him a suspicious look and walk away. Along the way, there was an incident where a bigoted Demi-Human, unaware of my father’s true identity, grabbed him by the collar in a confrontational manner. Well, my Father has quite a bit of Defense Power these days, so he didn’t get a single scratch. Amidst all that… there was one person—a werewolf, I suppose?
“Hm? How to transform? What, you can’t even do that…? Oh well.”
But he generously agreed to my Father’s request.
“Really? Then could you please show us?”
“Sure.”
“Boo!”
It looked like things were going to work out smoothly. But then, a huge problem loomed large.
“Hey… what language is this guy speaking?”
“Huh? Oh…”
“Bu?”
That’s right. Keel was a Demi-Human who spoke the language of Melromarc. It seems the language of Siltvelt is different, so we couldn’t understand each other.
“W-well, if I translate…”
“Can you explain the magical aspects too?”
“Umm…”
“Sorry, but that’s impossible.”

With that, the kind Beastman walked away. This is a tough problem. It seems that mastering Magic is involved in the transformation process. My current Father can’t use Magic. And with the language barrier on top of that, we’ll have to ask a Demi-Human with transformation abilities who can speak Melromarc.
“Motoyasu-kun. Do you have any ideas?”
“My Big Sister’s older sister would be the perfect person for this, but…”
“Huh?”
“Anyone.”
“She’s a Beastman who looks like a killer whale and is from the same village as Keel.”
“Huh-huh?”
“Is her name Sadeena? Do you know where she is?”
“I haven’t the faintest idea.”

I don’t know where my Big Sister’s older sister is right now. To begin with, by the time I started living in my Father’s village, Big Sister’s older sister was already there, so I have no idea when she joined Father’s group. It must have been after the battle with the Spirit Tortoise, but where is she now, and what is she doing…?
“I guess we’ll have to put off learning about Keel’s transformation for now…”
Just as we were talking about that, Keel’s stomach growled. At the same time, Kou and Sakura-chan, who we’d brought along, also had their stomachs growl.
“Should we grab a bite to eat somewhere?”
“We’re going to go hunt down some monsters.”
“No, while we’re at it, let’s ask around at a tavern or something to see if there’s anyone skilled like that.”
“Understood.”

So, we headed to a tavern. Since Siltvelt is home to nocturnal Demi-Humans and is a country that never sleeps, there were quite a few people drinking at the tavern even though the sun hadn’t set yet. While we were all eating, Father was keeping an eye on our surroundings.
“Ooh? Ooh-ooh-ooh.”
“Don’t worry about it, Keel. It’s my job to set the stage, after all.”
“Ooh…”
As Father said that and scanned the tavern, his gaze suddenly froze on a certain spot.
“Motoyasu! Motoyasu. Look! Look!”
“What’s the matter?”
My Father tapped me on the shoulder and pointed. When I looked in that direction, there was a Panda drinking boisterously with a few Beastmen.
“A panda! So there are even panda Beastmen in this other world, huh?”
“Huh? What’s up?”

Perhaps annoyed by my Father pointing at him, the panda Beastman was staggering over toward us with a drunken gait. What’s this all about? If you’re trying to harm my Father, I, Motoyasu, will make a bloody mess of you.
“Motoyasu, calm down. It’s not like she’s actually hostile or anything.”
After holding me back, my father stood up and gave the Panda Beastman a slight bow.
“I’m sorry. Since I’m from the countryside, I got a little excited when I saw such a rare Demi-Human.”
“Hmph… So that’s why you were pointing at me.”

Her voice is a bit high-pitched. It seems she’s actually a female Beastman. But she’s so well-built that she looks like a man to me. A Beastman impressive enough to make even me mistake her for a man… she’s quite something.
“I’m truly sorry.”
“Boo!”
“Huh? What’s your problem? I’m the one who’s been wronged here!”
“Boo-boo-boo-boo!”
“I was enjoying my drink, and you’re the one who interrupted me… wearing those flashy clothes.”
“B-b-b-boo!”
“What’s so great about dressing like this anyway? Then just take it off. What’s so good about that wimpy outfit?”
My father stops Keel just as he’s about to fly into a rage and lunge at him. At the same time, Sakura-chan tries to stand up, but my father stops her too.
“Hold on, hold on. Calm down, Keel.”
Pushing Keel back, my father turns to face the Panda Beastman.
“I’d like to ask you something. Since you were able to talk with Keel, I assume it’s safe to say you’re bilingual, right?”
“Huh? Well, if you’re a mercenary, you’d normally be able to hold a conversation, wouldn’t you?”
“A mercenary… I see. So you’re someone who travels to various countries to fight, is that correct?”
My father launched into his sales pitch. The panda beastman seemed to be overwhelmed by my Father’s presence and took a step back.
“Of course. That’s just how mercenaries are—that’s how I’ve made my living.”
“I see. Well, there’s one more thing I’d like to ask… You noticed when I pointed at you, but… why have you been staring exclusively at my companion, Keel, this whole time? Could you tell me?”
Huh? Come to think of it, this panda beastman has been staring at Keel the whole time. Does he not like him or something? Or does he think Keel’s tail looks delicious, just like Kou does?
“Father.”
“What? Motoyasu.”
I whispered to my father. It was just my own take on his question. Then my father nodded as if he understood.
“Thanks. Okay, just watch quietly for a bit.”
Just as my Father answered with such confidence, the Panda Beastman replied frantically.
“W-well… it’s obvious—I hate wimps!”
“…Really?”
“You! What are you trying to say?!”
My father took out the ribbon he’d prepared for Keel, tied it into a bow, and showed it to him. Then he handed it to the Panda Beastman.
“Isn’t it because you’re concerned about Keel’s outfit?”
“Th-that’s exactly why I don’t like it—it’s too flashy!”
“Then why didn’t you throw away the ribbon I gave you?”
“Ah…”
After being called out, the panda beastman flung the ribbon back at my Father.
“Nope! I didn’t even look at that outfit!”
“Motoyasu-kun. Can you prepare an outfit that suits this person?”
“It’s not impossible.”
After all, there are occasionally Filolial-samas who want to wear clothes in their Filolial form. As long as I know the size, I can make any kind of outfit.
“He’s the one who sewed that outfit for me. So I can definitely get you some clothes. If you’re mad, I’ll give them to you, so please forgive me.”
“Hah, don’t mess with me! Who’s going to wear clothes like that?! There’s no way they’d look good on a body like this!”

My Father gave a sly grin. I, too, recalled the days when I used to chase pigs, and I think I sort of understood. There was a pig who, to keep up appearances, acted serious and uninterested in that sort of thing, but actually had a fancy hobby. I remember there were lots of cute little trinkets in that pig’s room.
What he let slip at the end was his true feelings. “It doesn’t suit me.” Saying that was his downfall.
Based on my guess and his confession, Father completely understood why the other guy had come after us.
